response.sql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT m.zoneref, m.facetfaces, s.entrystat
  FROM scanmesh m
  JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(facetfaces) AS base
  FROM matched
  WHERE facetfaces IS NOT NULL
),
site_avg AS (
  SELECT zoneref, entrystat, AVG(facetfaces) AS site_avg
  FROM matched
  WHERE facetfaces IS NOT NULL AND entrystat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY zoneref, entrystat
),
status_avg AS (
  SELECT entrystat, AVG(site_avg) AS status_avg
  FROM site_avg
  GROUP BY entrystat
),
kept AS (
  SELECT sa.site_avg, st.status_avg, b.base
  FROM site_avg sa
  JOIN status_avg st ON st.entrystat = sa.entrystat
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE sa.site_avg > st.status_avg
    AND b.base IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  AVG(site_avg) AS avg_kept_site_average,
  AVG(site_avg - base) AS avg_excess_over_baseline,
  AVG(site_avg - status_avg) AS avg_excess_over_status_average
FROM kept;

assumptions.assumption: Missing values are SQL NULLs only; an empty-string entrystat or facetfaces is not treated as missing. A site whose mesh records all have NULL facetfaces gets no site average and is left out of its status average.

The overall baseline is AVG(facetfaces) over every matched mesh record with a non-null face count, including records whose site has a NULL entrystat. If no such record exists, the baseline is NULL and the query returns a single row of NULLs, meaning no sites qualify.
